notes: «حدثنا أبي ومحمد بن الحسن ... قالا» : the compiler's two teachers, one level; «أبي» is the compiler's father (relation).
«جميعا عن» marks two convergences (Sa'd with Abdullah, then Muhammad b. Isa, Ya'qub and Ibrahim); each is one level, in text order.
«أنه سمع من سلمان وأبي ذر والمقداد» : Sulaym heard from the three Companions together; the Prophet is not a link.
